column1: # Curated: the fuel mix of new motorcycles by model year, as fuel:year=share anchors (as in fuels.tsv); petrol is what is left. Country * holds the mix of every country without its own row. Rounded from the IEA Global EV Outlook's two-wheeler chapters, ACEM registrations, India's VAHAN dashboard, ABRACICLO (Brazilian flex-fuel motorcycles) and the makers' figures; electric two-wheelers here are licensed electric motorcycles and scooters, not electric bicycles.
